## Type

## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added/updated for the change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated (for user-visible changes)
- [ ] If generated URLs change: migration note included and discussed in an issue first
- [ ] If perf-relevant: `python tests/bench.py` numbers included
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies (Jinja2 is the only one allowed without discussion)
